description: This is a Python script that primarily defines a function 'write_config' for generating and installing JSON configuration files for plugins. It includes handling for external script paths, argument parsing, conditional logic for different generator versions, and commentary about license and copyright.

methods.name: write_config
methods.description: Main function to generate and install plugin configuration JSON files, with arguments to control plugin list, class name, locator, component, install path, filename, and other parameters. It handles different config generator versions, template files, and optional legacy support, including comparison and installation of generated files.
